#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N; cin >> N;
    int M = 3;
    vector<int> A(M), B(M);
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) cin >> A[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) cin >> B[i];

    int initial_sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        initial_sum += min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
    }

    int size = 2 * M + 2;
    int s = 2 * M;
    int t = 2 * M + 1;

    // Graph represented as adjacency list: each edge is (to, capacity, rev)
    vector<vector<array<long long, 3>>> graph(size);

    auto add_edge = [&](int u, int v, long long cap) {
        graph[u].push_back({v, cap, (long long)graph[v].size()});
        graph[v].push_back({u, 0, (long long)graph[u].size() - 1});
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        add_edge(s, i, N);
        add_edge(M + i, t, B[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + i, A[i]);
        add_edge(i, M + ((i - 1 + M) % M), A[i]);
    }

    vector<int> level(size);
    vector<int> iter(size);

    auto bfs = [&](int s) {
        std::fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        std::queue<int> que;
        que.push(s);
        while (!que.empty()) {
            int v = que.front(); que.pop();
            for (auto &e : graph[v]) {
                int to = e[0];
                long long cap = e[1];
                if (cap > 0 && level[to] < 0) {
                    level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                    que.push(to);
                }
            }
        }
    };

    auto send_flow = [&](int v, int t, long long flow) -> long long {
        if (v == t) return flow;
        for (int &i = iter[v]; i < (int)graph[v].size(); i++) {
            auto &e = graph[v][i];
            int to = e[0];
            long long cap = e[1];
            int rev = e[2];
            if (cap > 0 && level[v] < level[to]) {
                long long pushed = send_flow(to, t, std::min(flow, cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e[1] -= pushed;
                    graph[to][rev][1] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    };

    long long max_flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        bfs(s);
        if (level[t] < 0) break;
        std::fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
        while (true) {
            long long pushed = send_flow(s, t, 1000000000LL);
            if (pushed == 0) break;
            max_flow += pushed;
        }
    }

    long long res = N - max_flow;
    cout << res << " " << initial_sum << "\n";

    return 0;
}
